catalog.title: 1977 Seiko Catalog Vol.2
catalog.note: JDM annual, companion to Vol.1 with the same printing. Each caption prints the ref (●QNL020) and list price (円), then the movement code — a four-digit calibre or a family code (48GQW, 58KQW, 43TPW, 75TPW, 22MLW, 29MLW, 11S, 17QS, 88ST …) — with jewels (石) where printed and the case material (SS, HSS, SGP, HGP, GC, ASGP/AWGP/APDP A-grade plated, WGP, PDP palladium, SS(TPDP), SILV silver, GF/WGF, 14K·YG/WG, ACRP chrome-plated, ALM light alloy, PC plastic, TINSB titanium), a feature line (crystal, water resistance, battery life), the case code printed as CCCC<case-dial> (the bracketed part is kept as caseDialCode, the full line in `code`) and a box with either the bracelet/chain/cord code (X…) or the strap width in mm. `caliber` is the printed movement number, or the four-digit prefix of the case code where the movement is printed as a family code (58KQW → 5856, 22MLW → 2206, LM36 → 5740); family codes with a shorter prefix (11S, 17QS, 87ST, 88ST) leave it blank, and no CCCC-NNNN case–movement ref is printed. The scan skips printed pages 16, 22, 34, 44, 50, 52, 58, 59, 64 and 73. This copy carries pen marks: the ref/price lines on printed pages 18, 19 and 24 are outlined by hand and one bracelet code (DPT804) is corrected by hand. On the two diver pages the ref and price are printed in light blue over an underwater photo and cannot be read in this scan, so they are left blank.
catalog.method: Vision transcription of 250 DPI renders (Oct 2026): every pictured watch boxed on per-page check sheets (ruled-grid cell detector plus hand-drawn cells on the free-layout pages) and every field verified against 400–1200 DPI caption crops of the PDF.
